wins: Maintained consistent reward acquisition (50) per episode despite failures, indicating the agent followed a repeatable path through the scenario.
High mentor call usage suggests the agent aggressively sought external guidance, which can be refined into targeted decision points.
fails: Zero success rate indicates the agent never completed the mission objective across the episode, requiring structural changes in strategy.
Heavy reliance on mentor calls (10) with no success implies failure to internalize learned behaviors between calls.
key_outcomes.summary: Agent repeatedly earned reward yet failed to finalize objectives, showing predictable but incomplete behavior; urgent adjustments needed to convert partial progress into full success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent repeatedly stalled after initial reconnaissance without progressing to exploitation, often waiting for mentor guidance instead of acting autonomously.
